_comment: Phase 2 input. The only change from provision is the synchronous policy: from '*' to an explicitly named ANY 1 over all four nodes. That is the exact transition being made in production, so it is the one the test performs -- widening an already-named list would not reproduce it.
_comment_pgbackrest: pgBackRest encrypts its repository by default (repo_cipher_type aes-256-cbc) and refuses to configure without a passphrase. A throwaway value here; a real deployment supplies this from its secret store.
_comment_failover: Automatic failover is disabled, matching the deployment. The collection DEFAULTS repmgr_failover to 'automatic', so leaving this unset gives you repmgrd promoting a standby on its own -- which is finding EDB-01, and which was observed here: repmgrd promoted a node before the test's manual promotion ran, and repmgr then refused the second promotion.
